maps.name: Mammoth Valley
maps.blurb: One long road through the meadow. Learn the robots.

maps.name: Glacier Pass
maps.blurb: A shorter road and a frozen lake where you can't build. Tougher robots.

maps.name: Volcano Ridge
maps.blurb: Two portals. Lava everywhere. Two Prime Walkers at once.

maps.name: River Delta
maps.blurb: The river splits the valley. Only one bridge crosses it, and you can't build on water.

maps.name: Desert Citadel
maps.blurb: Dunes and ruins crowd a short road. Shield Bots arrive early.

maps.name: Copper Canyon
maps.blurb: Two portals in the mines. Two Siege Crawlers at the end.

maps.name: Highland Ford
maps.blurb: Heather hills and a cold stream. Ironclads march in armored lines.

maps.name: Ember Forge
maps.blurb: The tribe's forges glow. The Iron Colossus stomps and shuts down nearby towers.

maps.name: Mirefen Bog
maps.blurb: Two plank roads through the marsh. Twin Colossi at the end.

maps.name: Olive Hills
maps.blurb: Hover Drones fly: Brute and Siege towers can't hit them.

maps.name: Marble Coast
maps.blurb: A sea inlet cuts the coast. The Hydra splits into three heads.

maps.name: Acropolis
maps.blurb: Defend the temple hill from two sides.

maps.name: Hedgerow Fields
maps.blurb: Cloakers are invisible until a Control tower or your hero spots them.

maps.name: Castle Siege
maps.blurb: The Black Knight's shield regrows fast. Hit it hard and keep hitting.

maps.name: Darkwood
maps.blurb: Twisting forest roads full of cloakers.

maps.name: Smuggler's Harbor
maps.blurb: Bombers fly in from the sea and knock out towers when they crash.

maps.name: Star Fort
maps.blurb: Hold the fort against the Dreadnought Walker.

maps.name: Jungle Outpost
maps.blurb: Two jungle trails, endless bombers.

maps.name: Railyard
maps.blurb: Steam Tanks repair themselves. Burst them down.

maps.name: Foundry Row
maps.blurb: The Juggernaut speeds up when it's hurt.

maps.name: Smog City
maps.blurb: Fog, soot and two Juggernauts.

maps.name: Suburbia
maps.blurb: Stealth Jets fly and hide. You need spotters.

maps.name: Airbase
maps.blurb: The Hunter-Killer is invisible unless spotted.

maps.name: Downtown
maps.blurb: Skyscrapers, two highways, no mercy.

maps.name: Neon Grid
maps.blurb: Nano Swarms burst into mites when destroyed.

maps.name: Dish Array
maps.blurb: The Orbital Uplink heals and shields every robot near it.

maps.name: Cleanroom
maps.blurb: The lab where it all began.

maps.name: Server Hall
maps.blurb: You're inside. Sentinels shield and heal each other.

maps.name: Coolant Vaults
maps.blurb: Frozen pipes and a gauntlet of Sentinels.

maps.name: The Core
maps.blurb: End it. Destroy THE CORE.
